# Slice 3: the proof behind records 32 and 34, and the stray record 33

Records 32 (RED) and 34 (GREEN) ran `python3 ~/.cache/seen116/prove_changed.py`, a file outside the repository: the implementer kept it out of the scratchpad because that path carries the session id, which the harness refuses in a record. So that the command a reviewer reads is reproducible, its text is transcribed here verbatim. It loads ci.yml, takes the `mutation` job's `changed` step and executes its own `run` text with bash against the real repository (merge-base main HEAD widens to all of src because this branch changes stryker.config.mjs; BASE=HEAD skips) and against a synthetic repository (a selective change, a test-only change that skips, a vitest.config.ts change that widens).

Record 33 is a stray: a `check --phase red -- true` the implementer ran by mistake while inspecting the journal, exit 0, a RED that did not fail. It is cited by nothing; slice 3's RED is record 32.

Locally, `stryker run stryker.config.mjs --incremental --mutate src/index.ts` took 5.6 s, and a second run reused 5 of 5 mutants in 3.7 s. That is not the criterion's figure: the ten-minute measurement is the job's duration on this ticket's own pull request, to be quoted in the Outcome.

```python
"""Runs the mutation job's own `changed` step from ci.yml against real and synthetic ranges."""
import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile, yaml

REPO = "/Users/ruudvanengelenhoven/Development/seene"
wf = yaml.safe_load(open(f"{REPO}/.github/workflows/ci.yml"))
job = wf["jobs"].get("mutation")
assert job, "ci.yml has no `mutation` job"
assert job.get("if") == "github.event_name == 'pull_request'", job.get("if")
step = next((s for s in job["steps"] if s.get("id") == "changed"), None)
assert step, "the mutation job has no step with id `changed`"
script = step["run"]
assert "${{" not in script, "an expression is interpolated straight into run:"

def run(cwd, base):
    out = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile("w+", delete=False)
    env = dict(os.environ, BASE=base, GITHUB_OUTPUT=out.name)
    r = subprocess.run(["bash", "-eo", "pipefail", "-c", script], cwd=cwd, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
    assert r.returncode == 0, r.stderr
    kv = dict(l.rstrip("\n").split("=", 1) for l in open(out.name) if "=" in l)
    print(r.stdout.strip()); return kv

def git(cwd, *a): return subprocess.run(["git", *a], cwd=cwd, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()

# (a) the real repo: this branch changes the stryker config, so all of src.
base = git(REPO, "merge-base", "main", "HEAD")
kv = run(REPO, base)
assert kv["any"] == "true", kv
assert kv["files"].startswith("src/**/*.ts"), kv
# (b) nothing changed.
kv = run(REPO, git(REPO, "rev-parse", "HEAD"))
assert kv["any"] == "false", kv
assert kv.get("files", "") == "", kv

# (c) a synthetic repo for the selective path.
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
def w(p, t="x\n"):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(f"{d}/{p}"), exist_ok=True); open(f"{d}/{p}", "w").write(t)
git(d, "init", "-q"); git(d, "config", "user.email", "t@t"); git(d, "config", "user.name", "t")
w("packages/core/src/a.ts"); w("packages/core/src/b.ts"); w("packages/core/src/a.test.ts"); w("apps/api/src/c.ts"); w("README.md")
git(d, "add", "-A"); git(d, "commit", "-qm", "base"); b0 = git(d, "rev-parse", "HEAD")
w("packages/core/src/a.ts", "y\n"); w("packages/core/src/n/new.ts"); w("packages/core/src/a.test.ts", "y\n"); w("apps/api/src/c.ts", "y\n")
git(d, "add", "-A"); git(d, "commit", "-qm", "change")
kv = run(d, b0)
assert kv["any"] == "true" and kv["files"] == "src/a.ts,src/n/new.ts", kv
# only tests and other packages changed: skip.
b1 = git(d, "rev-parse", "HEAD"); w("packages/core/src/b.test.ts"); w("apps/api/src/c.ts", "z\n"); w("README.md", "z\n")
git(d, "add", "-A"); git(d, "commit", "-qm", "noise")
kv = run(d, b1); assert kv["any"] == "false", kv
# a changed vitest config widens to all of src.
b2 = git(d, "rev-parse", "HEAD"); w("packages/core/vitest.config.ts"); git(d, "add", "-A"); git(d, "commit", "-qm", "cfg")
kv = run(d, b2); assert kv["any"] == "true" and kv["files"].startswith("src/**/*.ts"), kv
print("ALL PROVED")
```
